subtitle: Strength training, your server
promotionalText: Plan, run and review your gym sessions, kept in your own substrate and saved to Apple Health.
description:
Substrate Workouts runs your strength sessions in the gym. It works on its own on your iPhone, and keeps your training in your substrate, the personal server you run or choose, once you sign in to one.

• Routines by folder; start one, or an empty session
• Exercises in any order, supersets, warm-up, drop and myo-rep sets, timed sets and RPE
• Rest timers that notify when rest ends, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen
• A suggested load and rep count for your next set, from this session and earlier ones
• History, stats across routines, and every exercise with its estimated 1RM trend
• Each finished session saved to Apple Health, when you allow it
• Import your history from Hevy

To keep your training in your substrate, sign in from Settings with your server's address and approve what the app may do there.
